fine_lines.title: myself vs me after prepositions of place
fine_lines.explanation_ar: نستخدم الضمير الانعكاسي عندما يعود على الفاعل: I was making myself dinner. لكن بعد حروف جر المكان (next to, in front of, behind, near) نستخدم الضمير العادي: I put the baby next to me (وليس next to myself).
fine_lines.explanation_en: Use a reflexive pronoun when it refers to the subject: I was making myself dinner. But after prepositions of place (next to, in front of, behind, near), use a normal pronoun: I put the baby next to me (not next to myself).

fine_lines.explanation_ar: proud of = فخور بشيء جيد. ashamed of = خجلان من شيء سيئ فعلته. الاثنان يأتيان مع of.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Proud of = happy about something good. Ashamed of = feeling bad about something wrong. Both take of.

grammar.title: Reflexive pronouns: when to use them and when not to
grammar.explanation_ar: 1) نستخدم الضمير الانعكاسي عندما يعود على فاعل الجملة: I was making myself a salad. 2) يمكن استخدامه للتأكيد بمعنى «بنفسي»: I made them myself. 3) لا نستخدمه بعد حروف جر المكان مثل next to, in front of, behind؛ نستخدم الضمير العادي: I put my baby in front of me. مثال يجمع الحالتين: While I was making myself dinner, I put Baby next to me.
grammar.explanation_en: 1) Use a reflexive pronoun when it refers to the subject: I was making myself a salad. 2) Use it for emphasis (I did it, not someone else): I made them myself. 3) Don't use it after prepositions of place like next to, in front of, behind; use a normal pronoun: I put my baby in front of me. Both in one sentence: While I was making myself dinner, I put Baby next to me.
examples: I was making myself a salad.
I put my flour baby in front of me.
I made them myself this morning.
Ms. Weaver instructed them to do everything by themselves.
